Alex Formenton Signs One-Year Deal with Edmonton Oilers

Alex Formenton, a player from the 2018 World Junior Championship team, has signed a one-year contract with the Edmonton Oilers. The signing follows his acquittal in a related legal matter. Specific details of the contract, such as salary or duration beyond one year, were not provided in the coverage.
